title: Preserve native-history and odd-E8 research handoff (no new kappa)
body:
This documentation and evidence handoff preserves the October 23–25 contribution sequences and the later native-history/odd-E8 investigation. The [entry point](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fe409365f36d0a2f907266cb1b6357322e1d540/docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/README.md) links the completed results and the current continuation point. The [stop decisions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fe409365f36d0a2f907266cb1b6357322e1d540/docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/EXPERIMENTS.md) distinguish exact scoped results, finite searches, time limits, and unbuilt ideas.

**No new kappa or complete supplier is claimed.** The ten existing PRs were already merged by maintainers. All 77 package files match their submitted Git blobs in base `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`; [RETENTION.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fe409365f36d0a2f907266cb1b6357322e1d540/docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/RETENTION.json) records the heads and successful hosted runs. Their main-ledger status remains partially reviewed. The selected conditional kappa stays `0.003027288235`.

The handoff also preserves the [small E retained-history test](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fe409365f36d0a2f907266cb1b6357322e1d540/docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/e-history/README.md). Exact rational spans reject the two negative targets after all retained values and all 76 one-axis queries are granted together. The changed spectral control recovers all four targets. This is a four-input, four-axis group-algebra fixture; it is not a result about the actual large caller or all physical decoders.

The unchanged source fixture comes from THU New Media Research Center's [PR #5464](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5464), [exact original file](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/56ba6d7d609124d71c067d6a380caed573963f8f/research/odd-e8-lowrank-e-native/N3-PROGRAM.json). The handoff separately records that PR's newer full120 construction and the remaining negative decoder. Credit for that work and for [PR #5508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5508) remains with their source authors. Earlier native, geometry, precision and parity-projector credit is retained at the linked results.

Python 3.12.13 and the standard library suffice. Run in a disposable copy because the screens write receipts:

```sh
cd docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/e-history
python3.12 -B history_module.py --exact
python3.12 -O -B history_module.py --exact
python3.12 -B verify_control.py
python3.12 -O -B verify_control.py
python3.12 -B paid_return_screen.py
```

All five commands passed at closeout. Exact history status is `EXACT_RATIONAL_HISTORY_SCREEN`; the control reports `PASS_EXACT_CONTROL_AT_LAMBDA_2`. Normal and optimized scientific fields match the saved receipts. [REPLAY.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fe409365f36d0a2f907266cb1b6357322e1d540/docs/research/handoffs/ali-romman-20261025/REPLAY.json) records the four exact runs. Source-blob, JSON/Python syntax, and diff checks passed. The complete large caller, selected cold replay, compiler, precision/storage admission, formal kernel, and independent review of this last test were not run. Earlier exploratory searches were not all rerun.

Only this handoff directory is added. Source packages and frontier files are unchanged. Original claims have been released and the answered control request is marked answered. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. This PR preserves evidence and open obligations; publication does not discharge them.
